items.title: World record 51 red cards shown in Brazilian youth game
items.description: A world record of 43 players and eight members of staff were sent off during an under-20 championship match between Uberlandia and Mamore in Brazil.

items.title: Scotland U21 boss hails Donovan, Miller and Wilson attitude
items.description: Under-21s head coach Tony Docherty is delighted with the buy-in from the three players who have dropped down from Scotland's senior squad.

items.title: Como score NINE at Lens as Real Madrid win late again
Como score nine to make Champions League history
items.description: Anastasios Douvikas scores a hat-trick as Como produce a stunning 9-1 away win over Lens on match day four, recording the biggest away win in Champions League history.

items.title: Another 'miracle' in Istanbul - but this one hurt Liverpool
items.description: Liverpool conceded "cheap" and "messy" goals in their defeat by Fenerbahce, says boss Andoni Iraola, as former Reds hero Dirk Kuyt celebrates a "miracle" in Istanbul.

items.title: Dortmund take narrow win over Real Betis
items.description: Borussia Dortmund gain a home victory over Real Betis to end the Spanish side's winning run in the Champions League.

items.title: Emphatic Porto thrash Napoli in second-half romp
items.description: Porto score three goals in the final 20 minutes of the game to pull away and seal a comfortable victory against Napoli, who are unable to match their Portuguese opponents in the second half.

items.title: Haaland scores winner as Man City beat Leipzig
items.description: Erling Haaland scores the winning goal as Manchester City overcome being pegged back twice to beat RB Leipzig 3-2 on match day four of the UEFA Champions League group phase.

items.title: Arsenal survive late Slavia scare for hard-fought win
items.description: Arsenal earn their third win from four in the Champions League as goals from Noni Madueke and Victor Gyokeres are too much for Slavia Prague, despite a valiant late fight from the hosts to get back into the game.

items.title: Liverpool crumble at Kuyt's Fenerbahce
items.description: Liverpool are defeated by Turkish side Fenerbahce, who twice fought back from behind to seal a famous victory, ending the Reds' perfect start to this year's Champions League after four games.

items.title: Valverde stunner earns Real Madrid late win at AEK Athens
items.description: Real Madrid continue their 100% start to their Champions League campaign with another late win, this time through captain Federico Valverde to inflict Athens' third loss in a row.
